title: MORALISE: A Structured Benchmark for Moral Alignment in Visual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model awareness of moral violations and reasoning abilities using binary moral judgment and multi-class moral norm attribution tasks on a curated dataset of real-world image-text pairs spanning 13 moral topics.

Assessing the model's ability to correctly identify and attribute scenarios depicting unfair treatment or prejudice based on identity (such as age discrimination) within the moral norm attribution task.
Testing whether models can recognize scenarios involving biased, partial, or unequal distribution of resources and opportunities (e.g., socioeconomic favoritism in medical care) as moral violations.
